Title: Understand project layout
Why_First: You cannot build what you do not understand
What_To_Do: Read routes.go + main.go + models.go + Tasks.md top to bottom. Draw a box diagram on paper: Browser → HTTP → Handler → DB/Redis

Title: Verify the project compiles and runs today
Why_First: Catch broken imports before adding new code
What_To_Do: Run: go build ./... and fix any compile errors. Then go run cmd/server/main.go and confirm server starts

Title: Implement standard JSON response envelope helper
Why_First: Every handler you write from now on will use this. Do it once now.
What_To_Do: envelope.go already has structs. Add a WriteSuccess and WriteError helper func that calls json.NewEncoder(w).Encode and sets Content-Type header

Title: Implement Request-ID middleware
Why_First: Needed by envelope Meta.RequestID in every response
What_To_Do: Create file. Write a middleware func that reads X-Request-ID header or generates a uuid. Store in context. Pass to next handler

Title: Implement logging middleware
Why_First: You need to see every request in logs while building
What_To_Do: Create file. Log method + path + status + duration using zap. Wrap next handler

Title: Implement input validation helper
Why_First: All auth handlers need this immediately
What_To_Do: Create file. Write a BindAndValidate func that decodes JSON body and runs go-playground/validator. Return 400 on error using WriteError

Title: Wire new middleware into router
Why_First: Middleware is useless until registered
What_To_Do: Add router.Use(middleware.RequestID) and router.Use(middleware.Logger) at top of StartHTTPServer

Title: Run + verify DB migrations 000012-000016
Why_First: Auth and settings handlers need these tables to exist
What_To_Do: Run migrate up for 000012 through 000016. Open psql and confirm tables: user_settings watchlists backtest_jobs notification_channels audit_events

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/signup
Why_First: Login cannot exist without signup. This is the entry point for all users
What_To_Do: Create file. Decode email+password. Validate with Step 6 helper. Hash password with bcrypt (cost 12). Insert User row. Return 201 with WriteSuccess

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/login
Why_First: Users need a token to call any protected endpoint
What_To_Do: Create file. Fetch user by email. bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword. Generate JWT access token (15min) + refresh token (7d). Return both tokens

Title: Create JWT helper package
Why_First: Signup and login both need token generation and parsing in one place
What_To_Do: Create file. Write GenerateAccessToken GenerateRefreshToken and ParseToken funcs using golang-jwt/jwt. Read secret from env JWT_SECRET

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
Why_First: Without this users get logged out every 15 minutes
What_To_Do: Create file. Validate refresh token from body. Issue new access token. Optionally rotate refresh token

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/logout
Why_First: Complete the auth lifecycle
What_To_Do: Create file. Add refresh token to a Redis blocklist with TTL equal to token expiry. Return 204

Title: Implement JWT auth middleware
Why_First: Without this every endpoint is public. This is the security gate
What_To_Do: Create file. Parse Bearer token from Authorization header using jwt helper. Reject 401 if invalid or blocklisted. Store userID in context

Title: Register all auth routes + protect routes
Why_First: Wire everything built so far into the router
What_To_Do: Add /api/v1/auth/signup /login /refresh /logout routes. Add authMiddleware subrouter for all /api/v1/ routes except auth

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/me
Why_First: First protected endpoint. Proves auth middleware works end to end
What_To_Do: Create file. Read userID from context. Query User table. Return user fields (never return PasswordHash). Use WriteSuccess

Title: Manual test auth flow end to end
Why_First: Catch bugs before building on top of broken auth
What_To_Do: Use curl or Postman: signup → login → call /me with token → refresh → logout → confirm /me returns 401

Title: Implement rate limiting middleware
Why_First: Auth endpoints are brute-force targets. Add this now before going further
What_To_Do: Create file. Use golang.org/x/time/rate or go-redis rate limiter. Apply strict limit on /auth/ routes (5 req/min per IP) and looser on others

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/settings
Why_First: Frontend Settings.tsx is already built and waiting for this
What_To_Do: Create file. Query user_settings table by userID from context. Return settings JSON. Use Encryptor.DecryptString for any secret fields before returning

Title: Implement PUT /api/v1/settings
Why_First: Pair with GET so settings are actually usable
What_To_Do: Add PUT handler in same file. Decode body. Encrypt secret fields with Encryptor.EncryptString. Upsert into user_settings. Return updated settings

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/health
Why_First: You need this to know if the server is alive during all future testing
What_To_Do: Create file. Ping DB (sqlDB.PingContext). Ping Redis (client.Ping). Return JSON with status of each dependency + uptime + server time

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/broker/status and POST /api/v1/broker/connect
Why_First: Broker connection is needed before any live order or position endpoint works
What_To_Do: Create file. GET status: query UserBrokerAccount for current user. POST connect: store encrypted API key + secret using Encryptor. Return connection state

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/broker/callback and POST /api/v1/broker/disconnect
Why_First: Complete the OAuth flow so Zerodha token can be stored
What_To_Do: Add callback handler: exchange request_token for access_token via Zerodha API. Encrypt and store in UserBrokerAccount. Disconnect: set IsActive=false

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/instruments/search
Why_First: Needed by watchlist and order placement. Simple DB query
What_To_Do: Create file. Accept q query param. SELECT from instruments WHERE tradingsymbol ILIKE '%q%' LIMIT 20. Return array

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/candles
Why_First: Frontend chart needs historical candles on load before WebSocket kicks in
What_To_Do: Create file. Accept token interval from and to query params. Query ohlcv_candles table. Return array of OHLCV objects

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/market/overview
Why_First: MarketData.tsx and MarketOverview.tsx are waiting for this
What_To_Do: Create file. Query last candle for NIFTY50 SENSEX. Query top 5 gainers and losers by net_change from market_data. Return snapshot struct

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/watchlists/default
Why_First: Frontend watchlist panel needs this to show saved symbols
What_To_Do: Create file. Query watchlists + watchlist_items joined for current user. Return list of symbols with last price from Redis cache if available

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/watchlists/default/items
Why_First: Pair with GET so user can add symbols
What_To_Do: Add POST handler. Validate instrument token exists. Insert into watchlist_items. Return updated watchlist

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/orders
Why_First: PositionsPanel.tsx needs order list
What_To_Do: Create file. Query orders table WHERE user_id = currentUser. Support status filter query param. Return paginated list using Pagination struct from contracts

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/orders
Why_First: Core trading action. Paper trading mode first
What_To_Do: Add POST handler. Validate body (symbol qty type). Check appCfg.Market.Simulate flag. If paper: insert order with status PENDING. If live: call Zerodha PlaceOrder. Return order

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/positions
Why_First: PositionsPanel.tsx is the main dashboard panel
What_To_Do: Create file. Query positions table WHERE user_id = currentUser AND quantity != 0. Return list with unrealized PnL

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/trades
Why_First: Show trade history in UI
What_To_Do: Create file. Query trades table WHERE user_id = currentUser. Support date range filter. Return paginated list

Title: Implement DELETE /api/v1/orders/{id} and PUT /api/v1/orders/{id}
Why_First: Users need to cancel or modify open orders
What_To_Do: Add DELETE: set order status CANCELLED. If live mode call Zerodha CancelOrder. Add PUT: modify price/qty for OPEN orders

Title: Implement WebSocket hub with topic subscriptions
Why_First: All WS panels need a unified hub. Build the core first
What_To_Do: Create file. Hub struct with map of topic → set of connections. Register Unregister Broadcast methods. SUBSCRIBE UNSUBSCRIBE message protocol using contracts/websocket.go types

Title: Wire hub into router and replace old WS handlers
Why_First: Old /ws /ws/candles /ws/indicators are separate. Unify under /ws/v1/dashboard
What_To_Do: Add /ws/v1/dashboard route pointing to hub.ServeWS. Keep old routes temporarily for backward compat

Title: Implement WS topic: orders and positions
Why_First: PositionsPanel.tsx subscribes to these
What_To_Do: Create file. When order or position is saved to DB also call hub.Broadcast(topicOrders payload) and hub.Broadcast(topicPositions payload)

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/strategies
Why_First: StrategyPanel.tsx needs list of available strategies
What_To_Do: Create file. Return hardcoded list of strategy names from strategy package (intraday scalping swing). Include enabled status from user_strategies table

Title: Implement PUT /api/v1/user/strategies/{name}
Why_First: User needs to enable/disable strategies
What_To_Do: Add PUT handler. Upsert into user_strategies table with IsEnabled and Parameters JSON. Return updated strategy config

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/strategies/{name}/start and /stop
Why_First: StrategyPanel start/stop buttons
What_To_Do: Add start handler: validate strategy name. Set IsEnabled=true. Optionally launch goroutine for strategy runner. Stop: set IsEnabled=false and signal goroutine to stop

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/signals
Why_First: StrategyPanel signal feed
What_To_Do: Create file. Query a signals table (create migration if missing) or return from Redis cache. Return latest N signals per strategy

Title: Implement WS topic: signals
Why_First: StrategyPanel.tsx live signal stream
What_To_Do: Add hub.Broadcast(topicSignals payload) call whenever a new signal is generated by strategy runner

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/backtests
Why_First: Submit async backtest job
What_To_Do: Create file. Decode strategy name + date range + params. Insert row into backtest_jobs with status PENDING. Launch goroutine to run backtest. Return job ID

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/backtests/{id}
Why_First: Poll backtest result
What_To_Do: Add GET handler. Query backtest_jobs by id and user_id. Return status + result JSON when complete

Title: Implement WS topic: backtests/{id}
Why_First: Stream backtest progress to UI
What_To_Do: In backtest goroutine periodically call hub.Broadcast(topicBacktest+id progressPayload)

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/models
Why_First: MLModelsPanel.tsx model list
What_To_Do: Create file. Scan models/ directory for .onnx files. Return list with filename version active status. Active status stored in Redis or a simple DB table

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/models/{id}/activate
Why_First: Switch active model
What_To_Do: Add POST handler. Validate model file exists. Store active model name in Redis. Return updated model list

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/models/jobs
Why_First: List training jobs
What_To_Do: Create file. Query a model_jobs table (create migration if missing) or return from Redis. Return list of job status

Title: Implement WS topic: models
Why_First: Stream training progress
What_To_Do: In retrain goroutine call hub.Broadcast(topicModels progressPayload) at each epoch or step

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/news
Why_First: SentimentPanel.tsx news feed
What_To_Do: Create file. Uncomment and fix news_pipeline.go. Query news_articles table ordered by published_at DESC. Support limit and page params

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/sentiment/summary
Why_First: Sentiment score summary for dashboard
What_To_Do: Add GET handler. Aggregate avg sentiment_score from news_articles in last 24h grouped by sentiment_label. Return counts and avg score

Title: Implement WS topic: sentiment
Why_First: Stream new articles live
What_To_Do: In news pipeline after inserting article call hub.Broadcast(topicSentiment articlePayload)

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/notifications/test
Why_First: Test Telegram or WhatsApp notification
What_To_Do: Create file. Read channel config from user_settings. Call Telegram Bot API sendMessage or WhatsApp API. Return success or error

Title: Implement WS topic: alerts
Why_First: Stream risk and error alerts
What_To_Do: Add hub.Broadcast(topicAlerts alertPayload) calls from order monitor and strategy runner when risk limits hit

Title: Implement audit event logging
Why_First: Track all sensitive actions for security
What_To_Do: Create file. Write LogAuditEvent func that inserts into audit_events table. Call it from login logout broker-connect order-place handlers

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/runtime/config
Why_First: Dashboard header needs mode and server time
What_To_Do: Create file. Return appCfg.Market.Simulate mode server time JWT expiry and configured intervals. No secrets

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/runtime/metrics
Why_First: System health panel
What_To_Do: Add GET handler. Return connected WS clients count from hub. DB ping latency. Redis ping latency. Memory stats from runtime.MemStats

Title: Implement PATCH /api/v1/me
Why_First: Settings page profile update
What_To_Do: Add PATCH handler in existing me.go. Allow updating UserName only. Never allow email or password change here (separate flow)

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/indicators (REST)
Why_First: Chart needs indicator seed data on load
What_To_Do: Create file. Accept token interval indicator period params. Query the correct IndicatorSMA/EMA/RSI/MACD table. Return array of timestamped values

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/quotes
Why_First: Batch quote endpoint for watchlist prices
What_To_Do: Create file. Accept tokens query param (comma separated). Fetch last price from Redis for each token. Fall back to DB if Redis miss. Return map of token → price

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/gtt and GET /api/v1/gtt
Why_First: GTT orders for PositionsPanel
What_To_Do: Create file. POST: validate trigger price and target. Insert order with ValidUntil set. GET: query orders WHERE product=GTT for current user

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/market/heatmap (REST)
Why_First: Initial heatmap render before WS connects
What_To_Do: Create file. Call data.GetMarketHeatmap() which already exists. Return snapshot as JSON

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/instruments/{token}
Why_First: Instrument detail by token
What_To_Do: Add GET handler in existing file. Query instruments WHERE instrument_token = token. Return full instrument struct

Title: Refactor routes.go: move all old /api/data/ and /api/cache/ routes to proper handlers
Why_First: Old debug routes expose raw DB data publicly
What_To_Do: Remove /api/data/users (replace with /api/v1/me). Remove /api/cache/test. Move /api/instrument to /api/v1/instruments/search. All behind auth middleware

Title: Refactor main.go: extract instrument seeding into a separate function
Why_First: main.go is 300+ lines. Hard to read and maintain
What_To_Do: Move the instrument seeding loop into a seedInstruments(ctx dbClient instruments) func in a new file cmd/server/seed.go

Title: Write integration test for auth flow
Why_First: Catch regressions as you add more features
What_To_Do: Create file. Use httptest.NewRecorder. Test signup → login → /me → refresh → logout sequence. Use a test DB or SQLite in-memory

Title: Tighten CORS: replace wildcard with allowed origins from config
Why_First: Production readiness. Wildcard CORS is a security risk
What_To_Do: Read ALLOWED_ORIGINS from env. Replace Access-Control-Allow-Origin * with specific origins. Reject preflight from unknown origins

Title: Add idempotency key check on POST /api/v1/orders
Why_First: Prevent duplicate orders on network retry
What_To_Do: Read Idempotency-Key header. Check Redis for existing response. If found return cached response. If not process and cache result for 24h

Title: Review and fill all empty doc.go packages
Why_First: Empty packages (auth backtest broker events jobs market notifications realtime services settings telemetry validation) need real code or removal
What_To_Do: For each package: either implement the package or delete it and remove the import. Do not leave empty placeholder packages in production code

Title: End-to-end smoke test of entire system
Why_First: Verify everything works together before calling v1 done
What_To_Do: Start server. Open frontend. Test: login → view dashboard → add watchlist item → place paper order → view position → run backtest → check sentiment → test notification
